name: cost-aware-agent-routing
title_zh: 按活计贵贱分派给不同身价 Agent 的路由器
tagline_zh: 同一批活，先派给便宜模型干，拿不准再升级给贵专家；协调员盯着别让两个 Agent 改同一处代码。
tagline_en: Assign easy tasks to cheap agents, escalate tricky ones to premium experts, and keep a coordinator from.
desc_en: Route software work between a low-cost support agent, premium frontend or backend specialists, and a coordinator. Use when assigning, splitting, escalating, reviewing, or handing off work across multiple coding agents, choosing a cheap versus premium model, or preventing overlapping agent work.
why_zh: 不是简单按难度分，而是把「值不值得花贵模型的钱」做成显式决策：每步都问当前活够不够格升级。
why_en: It makes cost-vs-quality an explicit per-task decision, not a guess—escalate only when the work justifies the premium model, so.
limit_zh: 只管路由和分工，不写代码也不审查结果。需要你先把任务拆成可独立分派的子任务；若子任务间耦合太深，它只能按顺序排队。
limit_en: Routes and assigns only—no coding or review. You must pre-split work into independent subtasks; tightly coupled tasks just queue up, losing.
title_en: Route coding tasks to cheap or premium agents by cost
